module: Handles mouse input of the drag race editor for zone editing: on each update, computes the camera-mouse ray, the scene raycast and the left button click/hold/release states. The result is read by the zone editor via getMouseInfo.
notes: During the raycast, forest collision is disabled and then re-enabled.
A click is taken into account if ImGui does not capture the mouse, or if the current edit mode is "Edit Drag Zone".
When nothing is hit, the click position is 100 m in front of the camera, with normal (0,0,1).
On the click frame (down), hold is forced to false.

updateMouseInfo.desc: Recomputes the mouseInfo table: camPos, ray, rayDir, rayCast, valid, down, hold, up and the positions/normals _downPos, _holdPos, _upPos, _downNormal, _holdNormal, _upNormal.

returns.desc: nil until updateMouseInfo has been called at least once.
